source_quote: There is no need to pass `example_layer_name` to the `enable_fa_quant` function here.

rule.description: 调用函数时只传入该函数实际使用的参数，不应传递函数体内部并不使用的冗余参数；冗余参数会让调用点产生"该参数会影响函数行为"的错觉，增加误读风险。
checkpoints: 检查被调用函数的函数体是否真的使用了传入的参数
检查是否存在历史遗留参数（重构后已不再需要但调用点仍在传递）
检查同名参数在多处调用时是否都存在同样的冗余传递

antipattern.code:
def _allocate_kv_cache(
    self,
    kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
) -> None:
    ...
    for kv_cache_group in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups:
        example_layer_name = kv_cache_group.layer_names[0]
        layer_kv_cache_spec = kv_cache_group.kv_cache_specs
        example_spec = layer_kv_cache_spec[example_layer_name]
        assert isinstance(example_spec, AttentionSpec)
        k_dim, v_dim = _get_attention_kv_cache_dims(example_layer_name, example_spec)
        # ❌ example_layer_name 是冗余参数，enable_fa_quant 函数体不使用它
        if enable_fa_quant(vllm_config, example_layer_name):
            k_factor, v_factor = vllm_config.quant_config.get_kv_quant_split_factor(
                example_layer_name, [k_dim, v_dim]
            )
